snapshot.text: Free health care for children, pregnant women and some groups, in a system still rebuilding after Ebola. A new Health Sector Strategic Plan covers 2026–2030, and the government signed a health agreement with the US.

priorities.title: Health Sector Strategic Plan 2026–2030
priorities.text: A workshop concluded development of the new strategic plan.

priorities.title: Antimicrobial resistance
priorities.text: Sierra Leone secured high-level commitments to accelerate action against AMR.

priorities.title: Specialist hospital care
priorities.text: New CT scanners and a burns unit at Connaught Hospital.
